a.name: Broadsheet
a.description: Editorial front page: heavy steel rule, column rule between copy and a tilted postcard photo with a caption plate.
a.differs_from: No built hero frames itself with rules: every row is plain, band or card, and none is a broadsheet with a column rule and a mounted postcard photo.

b.name: Litter filmstrip
b.description: Deep-steel panel inset in the page; the six puppies run as a contact strip along its foot, copy in two columns above.
b.differs_from: The photos sit under the copy, a media position no built hero uses, in an inset panel rather than a band or card; the mosaics are grids beside or above the copy.

c.name: Rail ticket
c.description: Edge-to-edge photo behind the band with the copy printed on a notched bone ticket, Carlisle to London route line.
c.differs_from: The photo is the background under an overlaid ticket, which no built hero does; the bleed heroes put the photo beside or above the copy, never under it.
